# dagsterplus_version (Data Source)

Retrieves the version of Dagster running in a deployment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dagsterplus_version" "prod" {
  deployment = "prod"
}

output "dagster_version" {
  value = data.dagsterplus_version.prod.version
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `deployment` (String) The name of the deployment to query.

### Read-Only

- `version` (String) The Dagster version string.
